label: Bible Study
prompt: I will heal their _____, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verse: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
note: The last chapter of Hosea — after all the heartbreak, God promises to love freely.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And ye shall eat in _____, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verse: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
note: After the locusts, a promise of plenty to eat — and 'my people shall never be ashamed.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: And through a _____ in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verse: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
note: Paul's escape from Damascus in his own words: let down through a window in a basket over the wall (Acts 9:25).

label: Deep Water
prompt: Who can understand his _____? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
verse: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.
note: David knows he has sins he can't even see, so he asks God to clean those out too.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For ever, O LORD, thy word is _____ in heaven.
verse: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
note: In a world of revisions, one thing is final: 'For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.'
